messages:
noah: Hey team, quick note  coffee machine sputtered and is out. Can someone run for coffee/snacks? I'm tied up until 11.
tia: I can go if someone lists needs. We are out of oat milk and granola bars.
omar: Please grab oat barista, almond milk, and a small box of gluten-free crackers.
kelly: Also grab a roll of paper towels  counters are messy.
noah: Thanks. Put $5 in the snack jar for me.
kitchen-bot: [auto] Facilities ticket #7890 opened for espresso unit. Assigned Technician: Jorge.
janet: Can we please label the broken machine "DO NOT USE"? It shocked Ben earlier.
tia: Will do the sign. Heading out in 8. DM me for cash.
omar: ps: snack cupboard has 2 protein bars, 0 oat milk, 1 almond.
kelly: If you pass the bakery, croissant for the table would be amazing.
tia: Back in 20 with oat barista, almond, gf crackers, paper towels, and croissants.
noah: Legend. Thanks! :coffee::croissant:
